(Japanese: '''お正月だよ！ポケットモンスタースペシャル！''' ''It's the New Year! {{tt|Pocket Monsters|Pokémon}} Special!'') is a two-hour special, which included a special 90-minute [[clip show]], that aired immediately after the original broadcast of the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP077|The Fourth Round Rumble]]''.

{{spoilers}}
